meta.title: Off-peak Sessions
meta.description: Run sessions only during DeepSeek off-peak hours: outside the off-peak window (00:30–08:30 by default) an enabled session's agent is held, prompts you send meanwhile stay queued, and work resumes automatically once off-peak begins. Toggle it per session; the window, time zone and the default for new sessions are hot-reloadable on the settings page.
